Marta S.: Passing Kyra (trial) to CS. Quick context: 14-day trial ends in 3 days, usage dipped after day 5 (~12 reqs/day). Blocking items: Okta SAML SSO, private-eval quote for PII, and a tokenization edge-case splitting compound names. Sam@kyra.ai is primary contact (PST). Dealsheet: https://redwood.co/deals/KY-433. Please own sales follow-up until handoff confirms.

Olivia CSM: Thanks Marta — looping in support & eng. I'll run a health triage and tentatively schedule kickoff tomorrow 10:00am PST. Flagging account: SSO_BLOCK = true, renewal_risk = medium-high if unresolved. @Raj (Support) can you open a ticket to collect Okta metadata? I'll send pre-kickoff checklist to Sam.

Raj (Support): Creating ticket SUP-3221. Sam, can you upload your Okta SAML metadata or provide admin access? Needed: SAML XML or SP/ACS values. SP entityID: https://private.redwood/kyra/sp, ACS: https://private.redwood/kyra/acs. @Evan (Eng) can you look at tokenization repro?

Evan (Eng): Quick question: hosted trial or private eval? If private, we need infra looped. I'll try to reproduce tokenization issue. Repro snippet: ```python
payload = {"prompt": "Customer name: 'Dr. Ana Mar\u00eda-Santos'\nResponse:", "max_tokens": 30}
# model: redwood-3b-quant``` Please post minimal failing sample/anonymized examples.

Marta S.: They're on hosted starter-eval. Sam confirmed Okta is IdP. Timezone PST; Sam can do 10:00am. Dealsheet notes PII concerns; I'll follow up on PO/contract.

Olivia CSM: Sending pre-kickoff template now. Checklist: - Collect SAML metadata (SUP-3221) - Provide anonymized tokenization sample - Confirm data residency & PII handling - Prepare private-eval quote - Schedule kickoff + enablement. I'll own scheduling + checklist.

Onboard Bot: Ticket SUP-3221 created and playbook "ssoconfig_v1" initiated.

Raj (Support): SUP-3221 assigned to Raj. Sam, please paste metadata into the ticket or link. Target: gather by EOD 2024-05-09.

Evan (Eng): Looked at logs Marta pasted. Suspect whitespace/normalization edge-case. Mitigation: set tokenizer.normalize_whitespace = True in runtime config and test. If still failing, ENG will prepare a small patch. Created ENG-6789 for triage, aim initial findings by 2024-05-09.

Olivia CSM: Owners & next steps recap: - Olivia: schedule kickoff + enablement (owner) — kickoff tentative 2024-05-10 10:00 PST - Raj: collect SAML metadata (SUP-3221) — due 2024-05-09 EOD - Evan: eng triage ENG-6789 — initial triage by 2024-05-09 - Marta: sales follow-ups on PO/quote - Renewal risk = MEDIUM-HIGH if SSO not resolved before trial end (2024-05-12). I'll update account health dashboard and notes.

Marta S.: Thanks — Sam will bring Okta admin access to kickoff. I'll send a ballpark private-eval estimate before EOD.

Sam (Kyra): Uploading SAML metadata to the ticket now and will join kickoff. Appreciate the quick response.

Olivia CSM: Posting calendar invite and marking tasks in tracker. Will close this thread once SUP-3221 & ENG-6789 show in-progress. :thumbsup:
